text:
eva (release): Heads-up — planning to lift the runtime pin for runtime v3.2 -> v3.3 in the EU/US regions this Saturday during the 02:00 UTC change window. Want a short vet/hold window and a clear rollback plan.

sam (eng): ack. are we unpinning by model group or globally? any SDK pin still needed?

marta (sre): Prefer staged by model-group. Longseq-heavy models should stay pinned until we validate kv-cache for >8k.

kevin (pm): can we get a short canary first (2% traffic) for 1h then expand? also pls add a note to release notes about possible p95 latency bump.

deploy-bot: scheduled change request created: `CR#202403-UNPIN-RUNTIME-177777` — canary rollout: 02:00 UTC, region=eu-west-1, canary=2%, expand=30m/60m. Trigger hooks: /hook/obs-checks.

jo (ops): doc checklist — update pinlist, set deploybot escape hatch, precreate rollback tag. I'll also reserve a one-hour on-call window.

sam (eng): quick compatibility note: v3.3 changes kernel selection default -> interleaved KV path. Non-quantized llama2q variants might experience +5-10% token CPU on warmups. Should be fine under canary but watch p50->p95 spread.

marta (sre): Rollback criteria proposal: error rate increase >0.5% over baseline for 5m OR p95 latency >1200ms sustained for 3 checks (1m resolution). If triggered, abort expansion and execute rollback tag `runtime-v3.2-pinback-177777`.

kevin (pm): Approved rollback criteria. Also add a quality check: degraded output rate on eval set >2% (prompt set: release/regressions/longseq-smoke).

sam (eng): Deploy snippet for canary (ops run):
```
deploy-bot trigger --cr CR#202403-UNPIN-RUNTIME-177777 \ 
  --region eu-west-1 --canary 2% --expand-steps 30m,60m \ 
  --rollback-tag runtime-v3.2-pinback-177777
```

jo (ops): I'll run the trigger and monitor. tagging @marta and @sam on the first 15m heartbeat.

marta (sre): monitoring list: error-rate, p95 latency, kv-cache miss rate, memory OOMs, host cpu steal. Dashboard: /dashboards/runtime/unpin-177777.

eva (release): please paste final release-note blurb here before EOD. Also add line for customers about expected no-downtime but possible token latency variance.

sam (eng): draft release note: "Runtime v3.3: kernel selection improvements and interleaved KV path for better memory utilization. Rolling canary in eu-west-1 02:00 UTC. If you rely on long-sequence, expect a brief warmup latency increase; contact support for protections."

kevin (pm): LGTM. can we add "pin remains for high-llama2q models until 3 validation passes"?

sam (eng): done.

marta (sre): one more ops note: if rollback occurs, please run `/ops/sync-pinlist runtime v3.2` and notify the regional infra leads.

deploy-bot: CR#202403-UNPIN-RUNTIME-177777 status: queued. Next action: `trigger` by jo at 02:00 UTC.

eva (release): thanks — moving to final go/no-go at the 23:00 UTC readiness check. :thumbsup:

jo (ops): I'll post a short status update at 02:15 and 02:45 during the canary.

marta (sre): standing by.

sam (eng): ping if you need to hold the canary, otherwise I'll be watching logs and eval regressions.

kevin (pm): thanks everyone — updating the release calendar and customer-facing note.
